mapper.select: -- CommunityMapper.CommunityVo SELECT b.id ,b.user_id ,b.title ,b.content ,b.isbn ,b.view_count ,b.create_dt ,b.update_dt ,u.email ,u.name FROM board b INNER JOIN public.user u ON b.user_id = u.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: -- CommunityMapper.insertCommunity INSERT INTO board( user_id ,title ,content ,isbn ,view_count ,create_dt ,update_dt ) VALUES ( #{userId} ,#{title} ,#{content} ,COALESCE(#{isbn}, 0) ,0 ,NOW() ,NOW() )
